meta.notes: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on all 55). Guides are this guide's own words, built from the official descriptions plus the cited guides. Five trophies were still unconfirmed by every guide on 18 Nov 2026 and are marked so in their guide text instead of guessed. Hidden flags follow GTA Zone's hidden set (28 hidden: 27 Bronze + 1 Gold).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. Work the roadmap below — story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup — and it unlocks on its own. There is no separate task behind it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is one of the first missions of Chapter 1 and cannot be missed — just follow the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock as you play; no side work is needed for this one.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before you leave Chapter 1 — that is the one thing in this stretch that can be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the map is opening up, so scan unfamiliar vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you travel — both feed the 100% checklist later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The big bank vaults open up in this chapter with the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — worth doing when it appears, since the 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission in Chapter 5. This is the last story trophy; after the credits, free roam stays open, so every remaining trophy can be cleaned up without starting over.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It unlocks by playing the story — no extra steps.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It unlocks by playing the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It unlocks by playing the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It unlocks by playing the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It unlocks by playing the story — and the airport itself matters for Catch Me If You Can later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It unlocks by playing the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and work the checklist: story done, 100 optional tasks, robberies (39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults), collectibles (15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos), 30 of 40 races won, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 15 Bret target decks, 200 of 277 vehicles, 50 of 66 weapons, 100 of 255 animals. You only need the listed portions, not everything — PowerPyx puts the checklist near 60% of true completion. Nothing on it is missable, and progress made before the story ends already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. Flying under bridges is reported as the quickest kind. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 — this trophy is a milestone on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: sports, races, shooting range, arcade, fishing and the rest. One try each is enough — no wins or medals needed. A good early trophy: sample everything as each activity unlocks.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. All 42 are also required for 100% completion, so this is not extra work on top of A Long Road — practice each range until the gold time or score clicks.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. The 100% checklist also wants all 42 Drone Time Trials finished, so run the trials at each spot while you are there instead of coming back.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count; the 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 won, so this comes naturally on the way to A Long Road. Mix race types to keep it fresh.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and beat him. Fishing opens up through the story; look for Cal at a fishing spot once the activity is available, then out-fish him in the challenge.
sources: KeenGamer — defeat Cal in a fishing challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one arcade game through to its end. Arcades are found around Leonida; finishing a single game is enough, so pick the one you enjoy most.
sources: KeenGamer — complete any one arcade game

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — his final mission is the one that pops this. Stranger strands stay open after the story, so there is no rush, but starting his chain early spreads the work out.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, including his final mission. Kenton is also tied to treasure sets, so his strand pairs well with collectible hunting.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission and stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. There are more strands than 8, so pick the ones you enjoy; Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each count as one strand, and each also has its own trophy for its final mission.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand — his final mission pops this. Like the other character strands, it stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand — his final mission pops this. Like the other character strands, it stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (10 locations, with Jason and Lucia). THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia offers a balcony meditation at Jason's house in the morning — do it before leaving Chapter 1, because that spot is gone after the chapter and it is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note: 100% completion only needs 15 of 18 spots, so this missable spot cannot cost you A Long Road.
sources: PowerPyx via KeenGamer — the one possibly missable trophy

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only. The exact animal is not confirmed yet (as of 18 Nov 2026) — Bret's Target Deck has 15 objectives, all needed for 100%, so work his hunts steadily and this should come with them.
sources: GTA Zone — Jason-only, exact animal unconfirmed

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets out of 18. Cards are scattered across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3 — this trophy is an early milestone, not the finish line.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations — any mix of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. Scan vehicles and landmarks as you travel so the count builds up naturally instead of becoming a late grind.
sources: GTA Zone — Landmarks / Curiosities / Sculptures mix

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Pick the 50 easiest; the 100% checklist wants 70, so this is a milestone on the way — leave the 10 hardest for last or skip them entirely.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape together. Stay in the same vehicle or on foot together until the stars clear — splitting up can fail it.
sources: KeenGamer — escape a four-star Wanted Level with your partner

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops and keep the heat on the whole way — if the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over.
sources: KeenGamer — three shops consecutively with your partner

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning everything unfamiliar from the start of the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies during that single use. Pick a fight with a group of enemies clustered together, and make every shot count before the focus ends.
sources: KeenGamer — five enemies during one Combat Focus

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate at Vice City International Airport, take off, and get about 1 km away. Expect a heavy police response — climb fast and fly straight out instead of circling the airport.
sources: GTA Zone — steal a passenger jet at a boarding gate

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The trophy's own description is the hint: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' Bring armor and expect the army to object.
sources: GTA Zone — steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before the alarm trips. A stealth approach beats a loud one here.
sources: KeenGamer — rob a jewelry store without detection

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The big vaults open with the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' in Chapter 4; the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this Silver is a stop on the way to the full set.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush one on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the cops. Armored trucks patrol regularly, so this is a matter of picking your moment.
sources: KeenGamer — rob an armored truck and escape

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida until the map fog is fully cleared (52 areas on PSN's counter). A plane is the fastest way to sweep the map — fly a grid over the state and watch the fog lift.
sources: GTA Zone — clear the fog, a plane is fastest

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gang Operations are marked around the state; one per gang is enough for this trophy, but all 39 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED (as of 18 Nov 2026): neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned down the exact trigger. The description points to drinking a cocktail at a spot overlooking Ocean Beach — try a beachfront bar, but do not trust any specific steps until a guide confirms them. This guide will not guess.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED (as of 18 Nov 2026): the description points to driving out through a vehicle showroom's window, but no guide has confirmed the exact method yet. The phrase 'in classic style' nods to the series' history — expect a showroom smash-and-grab once players crack the trigger.
sources: GTA Zone — unconfirmed, points to the showroom window

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. The description's 'follow-through' is a bowling pun — this is a robbery, not a game of bowling.
sources: GTA Zone — Kingpin Bowling gang operation, Port Gellhorn

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Working out together trains both at once, so pair their gym sessions instead of grinding each one alone.
sources: GTA Zone — max Strength for both, work out together

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It is a running total across the whole game; play normally and it builds up on its own. Warning from GTA Zone: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.
sources: GTA Zone — 500 Criminal Profile actions, Irredeemable is permanent

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: 'Second time's the charm.' Neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned down the exact trigger as of 18 Nov 2026. This guide will not guess — check back once players crack it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: 'What the hell just happened?' No guide has pinned down the exact trigger as of 18 Nov 2026. The name hints at something strange or unexplained in the world — this guide will not guess at it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.' No guide has confirmed the precise method yet; the wording suggests knocking enemies over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Treat any specific steps you read elsewhere as unverified until a guide confirms them.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total — bank jobs and vaults pay in Marked Bills, and GTA Zone reports Yasmani pays the most, so favour his jobs when you have the choice. The same $250,000 is also on the 100% checklist.
sources: GTA Zone — Yasmani pays the most

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. A running total — weapons, clothes, food and car mods all count. It will likely pop on its own during a normal playthrough, especially once you start buying gear for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties for sale (about $160,000 in total). The 4 story garages do not count — only the 8 purchasable ones. Save up during the story and buy them as they appear.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need a free garage space for each registration, so keep a slot open and register cars as you find ones worth keeping.
sources: GTA Zone — Moses gives the app in Chapter 2
